sources.name: ParaRev annotated subset
sources.relationship_notes: Dataset card declares CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The importer is opt-in and local-only. ParaRev is extracted from CASIMIR; do not count overlapping examples as independent. The license declaration does not resolve rights in underlying paper text; review before public redistribution or commercial use.

sources.name: CASIMIR
sources.relationship_notes: The Hugging Face dataset card declares MIT, but the corpus contains OpenReview scientific articles. Review upstream article rights and all included third-party content before use or redistribution.

sources.name: JFLEG
sources.reported_size: 1,503 source sentences across validation/test; four human correction references each (up to 6,012 sentence-level pairs)
sources.relationship_notes: The Hugging Face dataset card declares CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. An opt-in importer preserves the upstream validation/test split and four human references. This is a sentence-level GEC benchmark, not academic paragraph writing; keep it separate from the academic revision corpus.

sources.name: Individually licensed open-access papers
sources.relationship_notes: Review each article license and terms individually; open access alone is not a redistribution grant.

sources.name: British Academic Written English (BAWE)
sources.relationship_notes: Bulk XML/TXT corpus is available through the Oxford Text Archive. Access is described as free for non-commercial researchers who register and agree to conditions of use. Review the current OTA terms and permitted text redistribution/processing before acquisition; suitable as source-only student academic writing, not revision pairs.

sources.name: Michigan Corpus of Upper-level Student Papers (MICUSP)
sources.relationship_notes: University of Michigan states corpus files are freely available for study, research and teaching; commercial use requires prior permission and may require a fee. Confirm applicable terms and redistribution rights before bulk acquisition or publication. Suitable as source-only student writing, not revision pairs.

sources.name: ACL Anthology papers and metadata
sources.relationship_notes: An opt-in catalog importer downloads the official consolidated BibTeX metadata only. It does not fetch PDFs or full text. The official Anthology API recommends its GitHub metadata repository/Python package; per-paper text license and third-party material must be checked before any full-text acquisition.

sources.name: ParaRev full unannotated corpus
sources.relationship_notes: Dataset card declares CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The full file contains the 641-row manually annotated ParaRev evaluation subset; it is not an independent dataset. The importer uses matching stable record IDs to identify overlap. ParaRev is extracted from CASIMIR. Underlying article rights remain unresolved; local-only pending rights review.

sources.name: PubMed Central Open Access Subset
sources.relationship_notes: Only articles explicitly in the PMC Open Access Subset are candidates. Licenses vary by article; inspect each article's license. Automated retrieval must use NCBI-authorized PMC services (Cloud Service, OAI-PMH, E-Utilities, BioC); do not scrape the main site.

sources.name: Curated ACL Anthology research-paper references
sources.relationship_notes: Paper metadata and links only at this stage. ACL policy is publication-date based for ACL materials (pre-2016 CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; 2016 onward CC BY 4.0); third-party content is excluded. Verify individual paper and included material before text ingestion.
